LineComment.Text: Generate Motor/Pump Fail to Run Fault.(FTR)

AttributeList.Text:
Once the START_CMD output is issued from the PLC to the Motor/Pump, a 'Running' feedback should be detected within a pre-set time. In the event of non-receipt of the 'Running' feedback within this time, a Motor/Pump 'Fail to Run' alarm shall be generated. This alarm condition shall be maintained until the operator issues the 'Fault Reset' command from the HMI. The Motor/Pump shall be made available for the next operation, only after the 'Fault Reset'.
This alarm shall be generated only in the MCC-Auto Mode of operation.

Once the START_CMD output is issued from the PLC to the Motor/Pump, a 'Running' feedback should be detected within a pre-set time. In the event of non-receipt of the 'Running' feedback within this time, a Motor/Pump 'Fail to Run' alarm shall be generated. This alarm condition shall be maintained until the operator issues the 'Fault Reset' command from the HMI. The Motor/Pump shall be made available for the next operation, only after the 'Fault Reset'.
This alarm shall be generated only in the MCC-Auto Mode of operation.

LineComment.Text: Generate Motor/Pump Fail to Stop Fault.(FTS)

AttributeList.Text: If the Motor/Pump START_CMD output from the PLC is de-energised due to any of the interlocks, then the running feedback should be lost within the preset time . In the event of receipt of the running feedback even after this time, a Motor/Pump 'Fail to Stop' alarm shall be generated. This alarm condition shall be maintained until the operator issues the 'Fault Reset' command from the HMI. The Motor/Pump shall be made available for the next operation only after the 'Fault Reset'.

If the Motor/Pump START_CMD output from the PLC is de-energised due to any of the interlocks, then the running feedback should be lost within the preset time . In the event of receipt of the running feedback even after this time, a Motor/Pump 'Fail to Stop' alarm shall be generated. This alarm condition shall be maintained until the operator issues the 'Fault Reset' command from the HMI. The Motor/Pump shall be made available for the next operation only after the 'Fault Reset'.

If the Motor/Pump loses process interlock in running mode or Tripped electrical signal is lost, a Motor 'Tripped' alarm shall be generated. This alarm condition shall be maintained until the operator issues the 'Fault Reset' command from the HMI.
The Motor/Pump shall be made available for the next operation only after the 'Fault Reset'.

If the Motor/Pump loses process interlock in running mode or Tripped electrical signal is lost, a Motor 'Tripped' alarm shall be generated. This alarm condition shall be maintained until the operator issues the 'Fault Reset' command from the HMI.
The Motor/Pump shall be made available for the next operation only after the 'Fault Reset'.
